critical_findings.description: Exact duplicate images exist in primary benchmark (547.jpg is identical to 640.jpg, and 565.jpg is identical to 668.jpg). In the existing YOLO split, 640.jpg and 565.jpg are in 'train' while 547.jpg and 668.jpg are in 'val', causing validation evaluation leakage.

Near-duplicate drone inspection images of the same defect from slightly shifted viewpoint angles (perceptual dHash distance <= 2) were split across train and val (e.g. 189.jpg in train vs 172.jpg in val), artificially inflating test evaluation metrics.

The physics surrogate models (GradientBoosting regressors) were trained entirely on data/synthetic/aeroloss_multimodal_dataset.csv, which was generated by passing random uniforms through the analytical AeroLossPhysicsEngine formula. R2 = 0.999 is a mathematical tautology. Zero real-world empirical ground-truth pairs of blade defect photos linked to actual SCADA power loss exist in the repository.

The SCADA time series data/raw/T1.csv is from a ~3.6 MW wind turbine (max power 3618 kW), whereas the aerodynamic documentation (IEA Wind Task 46) and airfoil polars (FFA-W3-241) represent the IEA 15-MW reference turbine (rotor diameter 240m). Direct application of 15-MW equations to 3.6-MW SCADA creates order-of-magnitude scaling discrepancies.

Primary benchmark annotations exhibit severe class imbalance: surface_injure (412 objects) and hide_craze (342 objects) heavily outnumber thunderstrike (92 objects) and crack (224 objects). Thunderstrike represents only 5.8% of annotated defect instances.
All 1584 defect patches in data/processed/patches/ are 100% traceable to their originating raw images and exact XML bounding box coordinates via data/processed/defect_features.csv.

model_1_guardrail.blocking_item: Golden calibration benchmark for Usable / Review-Required / Unusable needs formal curation; negative sample set is too small (30 images).

model_2_yolo_detection.blocking_item: Requires deduplication, flight-grouped splitting (to eliminate leakages), and training at native 1024x1024 resolution with class-balanced augmentations on T4 GPU.

model_3_damage_characterization.blocking_item: Sweep-line 2D interval union algorithm is verified; spanwise r/R requires chord tapering geometry heuristics.

model_4_aerodynamic_energy_loss.blocking_item: Must decouple synthetic surrogate regressor from pipeline and use deterministic BEM / lookup table with explicit turbine scaling (3.6 MW vs 15 MW).

model_5_decision_support.blocking_item: Replace synthetic decision classifier with auditable DNV-ST-0361 rule matrix.

recommended_next_action: Implement flight-grouped deduplication and generate leak-free native 1024x1024 YOLO dataset splits, then proceed to Model 1 guardrail threshold calibration.
